# Adil Ahmad

> Product Design Manager at Qatar Airways (Doha). Portfolio: leadership case studies, product design craft, and AI experiments.

Adil Ahmad is a Product Design Manager leading digital product design at Qatar Airways in Doha, Qatar. His work focuses on design leadership, organisational design process, team building, and shipping product experiences. He is not a traditional design manager — his approach centres on trust, ownership, and delivery.

## Leadership case studies

- [Design Lab](https://adilahmad.co.uk/DesignLab.html): Strategic initiative to transform how product design operated across Qatar Airways digital products
